column1: # SHACL Core surface — the DENOMINATOR for capability coverage.
# Enumerated from the W3C SHACL Recommendation (https://www.w3.org/TR/shacl/),
# NOT from this directory's fixtures. That direction is the whole point: if the
# list were derived from the probes, every probe would extend the target it is
# measured against and the fraction would always read 100%.
# Adding a probe does NOT belong in this file. This file changes only when the
# specification does, or when a reading of it is corrected — and such a change
# is a reviewable event, not a side effect of writing a test.
# A row is MEASURED when fixtures/<feature>.shapes.ttl exists.
